holdings_flows.cypher:
MATCH (a:Advisor {id:$advisorId,tenant_id:'DEMO'})-[:MEMBER_OF]->(b:BuyingUnit)-[p:POSITION_AS_OF]->(i:Instrument)-[:OF_FUND]->(f:Fund)
WHERE p.as_of=date($asOf) AND p.currency='USD'
CALL (b,i) { OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[flow:FLOW_IN_PERIOD]->(i)
WHERE flow.period_start=date($periodStart) AND flow.period_end=date($periodEnd) AND flow.currency='USD'
RETURN sum(flow.sales_cents)/100.0 AS sales,sum(flow.redemptions_cents)/100.0 AS redemptions,count(flow) AS flowRecords }
RETURN a.full_name AS Advisor,f.name AS Fund,i.ticker AS Ticker,p.assets_cents/100.0 AS Assets_USD,
CASE WHEN flowRecords>0 THEN sales ELSE null END AS Sales_USD,
CASE WHEN flowRecords>0 THEN redemptions ELSE null END AS Redemptions_USD,
CASE WHEN flowRecords>0 THEN sales-redemptions ELSE null END AS Net_flow_USD,p.as_of AS Valuation_date
ORDER BY Assets_USD DESC LIMIT $limit
holdings_flows.graph_cypher:
MATCH p=(a:Advisor {id:$advisorId,tenant_id:'DEMO'})-[:MEMBER_OF]->(b:BuyingUnit)-[pos:POSITION_AS_OF]->(i:Instrument)-[:OF_FUND]->(f:Fund)
WHERE pos.as_of=date($asOf) AND pos.currency='USD'
OPTIONAL MATCH flow=(b)-[r:FLOW_IN_PERIOD]->(i) WHERE r.period_start=date($periodStart) AND r.period_end=date($periodEnd) AND r.currency='USD'
RETURN p,flow LIMIT $limit

similar_advisors.cypher:
MATCH (alex:Advisor {id:$advisorId,tenant_id:'DEMO'})
CALL (alex) {
 MATCH (alex)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(:BuyingUnit)-[p:POSITION_AS_OF]->(:Instrument)-[:OF_FUND]->(f:Fund)
 WHERE p.as_of=date($asOf) AND p.currency='USD' AND p.assets_cents>0
 WITH f,sum(p.assets_cents) AS assets
 RETURN collect({id:f.id,fund:f.name,assets:assets}) AS alexFunds,sum(assets) AS alexTotal
}
MATCH (peer:Advisor {tenant_id:'DEMO',dataset:'advisor-demo-20-v1'})
WHERE peer<>alex
CALL (peer) {
 MATCH (peer)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(:BuyingUnit)-[p:POSITION_AS_OF]->(:Instrument)-[:OF_FUND]->(f:Fund)
 WHERE p.as_of=date($asOf) AND p.currency='USD' AND p.assets_cents>0
 WITH f,sum(p.assets_cents) AS assets ORDER BY f.name
 RETURN collect({id:f.id,fund:f.name,assets:assets}) AS peerFunds,sum(assets) AS peerTotal
}
WITH alex,peer,alexFunds,alexTotal,peerFunds,peerTotal,
     [p IN peerFunds WHERE any(a IN alexFunds WHERE a.id=p.id)] AS shared
WHERE alexTotal>0 AND peerTotal>0 AND size(shared)>0
WITH alex,peer,peerFunds,peerTotal,shared,
     reduce(score=0.0,p IN shared | score +
       reduce(part=0.0,a IN [a IN alexFunds WHERE a.id=p.id] | part +
         CASE WHEN 1.0*a.assets/alexTotal < 1.0*p.assets/peerTotal
              THEN 1.0*a.assets/alexTotal ELSE 1.0*p.assets/peerTotal END)) AS overlap
RETURN peer.full_name AS Advisor,[p IN peerFunds | p.fund] AS Funds_held,
 [p IN shared | p.fund] AS Shared_funds,round(100.0*overlap,2) AS Allocation_overlap_pct,
 peerTotal/100.0 AS Book_assets_USD,
 reduce(total=0,p IN shared | total+p.assets)/100.0 AS Shared_fund_assets_USD
ORDER BY Allocation_overlap_pct DESC,Advisor ASC
LIMIT $limit

}
WITH alex,peer,alexFunds,alexTotal,peerFunds,peerTotal,

MATCH path=(advisor)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(:BuyingUnit)-[p:POSITION_AS_OF]->(:Instrument)-[:OF_FUND]->(:Fund)
WHERE p.as_of=date($asOf) AND p.currency='USD' AND p.assets_cents>0
RETURN path

semantic_content.cypher:
CALL db.index.vector.queryNodes('content_vectors',57,$queryEmbedding) YIELD node AS chunk,score
MATCH (doc:Document {tenant_id:'DEMO'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(v:DocumentVersion)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(chunk)
WHERE v.lifecycle='CURRENT' AND doc.type=$documentType
WITH doc,chunk,score ORDER BY score DESC
WITH doc,head(collect({score:score,text:chunk.text})) AS best
RETURN doc.name AS Content,round(best.score,4) AS Semantic_score,best.text AS Evidence,doc.approval_status AS Approval,doc.source_url AS Source_url
ORDER BY Semantic_score DESC LIMIT $limit
semantic_content.graph_cypher:
CALL db.index.vector.queryNodes('content_vectors',57,$queryEmbedding) YIELD node AS chunk,score
MATCH (doc:Document {tenant_id:'DEMO'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(v:DocumentVersion)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(chunk)
WHERE v.lifecycle='CURRENT' AND doc.type=$documentType
WITH doc,max(score) AS score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT $limit
MATCH p=(doc)-[:HAS_VERSION]->(v:DocumentVersion)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(:ContentChunk) WHERE v.lifecycle='CURRENT'
RETURN p

recommend_content.cypher:
MATCH (a:Advisor {id:$advisorId,tenant_id:'DEMO'})-[:HAS_STATEMENT]->(s:Statement {kind:'Meeting request'})-[:ABOUT_TOPIC]->(topic:Topic)
MATCH (s)-[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(seed:ContentChunk)<-[:HAS_CHUNK]-(nv:DocumentVersion)<-[:HAS_VERSION]-(note:Document)
WHERE nv.lifecycle='CURRENT'
CALL db.index.vector.queryNodes('content_vectors',57,seed.embedding) YIELD node AS chunk,score
MATCH (doc:Document {type:'ARTICLE',tenant_id:'DEMO'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(v:DocumentVersion)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(chunk)-[:ABOUT_TOPIC]->(topic)
WHERE v.lifecycle='CURRENT' AND doc.access_scope='LOCAL_SOURCE_REFERENCE'
WITH a,s,note,seed,topic,doc,max(score) AS semanticScore
RETURN doc.name AS Content_candidate,round(semanticScore,4) AS Semantic_score,topic.name AS Matched_need,
s.name AS Advisor_request,note.name AS Request_source,seed.text AS Request_evidence,
doc.approval_status AS Approval,'REVIEW_CANDIDATE' AS Recommendation_status
ORDER BY Semantic_score DESC,Content_candidate LIMIT $limit
recommend_content.graph_cypher:
MATCH (a:Advisor {id:$advisorId,tenant_id:'DEMO'})-[:HAS_STATEMENT]->(s:Statement {kind:'Meeting request'})-[:ABOUT_TOPIC]->(topic:Topic)
MATCH (s)-[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(seed:ContentChunk)<-[:HAS_CHUNK]-(nv:DocumentVersion)<-[:HAS_VERSION]-(note:Document)
WHERE nv.lifecycle='CURRENT'
CALL db.index.vector.queryNodes('content_vectors',57,seed.embedding) YIELD node AS chunk,score
MATCH (doc:Document {type:'ARTICLE',tenant_id:'DEMO'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(v:DocumentVersion)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(chunk)-[:ABOUT_TOPIC]->(topic)
WHERE v.lifecycle='CURRENT' AND doc.access_scope='LOCAL_SOURCE_REFERENCE'
WITH a,s,note,seed,topic,doc,max(score) AS semanticScore
WITH a,s,note,seed,topic,doc,semanticScore ORDER BY semanticScore DESC,doc.name LIMIT $limit
MATCH need=(a)-[:HAS_STATEMENT]->(s)-[:ABOUT_TOPIC]->(topic),
 evidence=(s)-[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(seed)<-[:HAS_CHUNK]-(nv:DocumentVersion)<-[:HAS_VERSION]-(note),
 content=(doc)-[:HAS_VERSION]->(v:DocumentVersion)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(:ContentChunk)-[:ABOUT_TOPIC]->(topic)
WHERE nv.lifecycle='CURRENT' AND v.lifecycle='CURRENT'
RETURN need,evidence,content

content_audience.cypher:
MATCH (doc:Document {id:$documentId,tenant_id:'DEMO'})-[:HAS_VERSION]->(v:DocumentVersion)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(:ContentChunk)-[:ABOUT_TOPIC]->(topic:Topic)
WHERE v.lifecycle='CURRENT'
MATCH (a:Advisor {tenant_id:'DEMO'})-[:HAS_STATEMENT]->(s:Statement {kind:'Meeting request'})-[:ABOUT_TOPIC]->(topic)
WHERE a.id<>$excludeAdvisorId
MATCH (s)-[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(c:ContentChunk)<-[:HAS_CHUNK]-(nv:DocumentVersion)<-[:HAS_VERSION]-(note:Document)
WHERE nv.lifecycle='CURRENT'
MATCH (owner:Employee)-[:COVERS_ADVISOR]->(a)
RETURN DISTINCT a.full_name AS Advisor,owner.full_name AS Salesperson,s.name AS Explicit_need,
note.name AS Source,c.text AS Evidence,doc.name AS Content_candidate,doc.approval_status AS Approval
ORDER BY Advisor LIMIT $limit

sales_followups.cypher:
MATCH (owner:Employee {id:$salespersonId,tenant_id:'DEMO'})-[:COVERS_ADVISOR]->(a:Advisor)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(book:BuyingUnit)
MATCH (book)-[flow:FLOW_IN_PERIOD]->(:Instrument)-[:OF_FUND]->(fund:Fund)
WHERE flow.period_start=date($periodStart) AND flow.period_end=date($periodEnd) AND flow.currency='USD'
WITH a,owner,fund,sum(flow.sales_cents) AS sales,sum(flow.redemptions_cents) AS redemptions
WHERE redemptions>sales
CALL (a,fund) {
 MATCH (a)-[visit:VISITED_PAGE]->(:Document)-[:ABOUT_PRODUCT]->(fund)
 WHERE visit.period_start=date($periodStart) AND visit.period_end=date($periodEnd)
 RETURN sum(visit.visit_count) AS visits
}
WITH a,owner,fund,sales,redemptions,visits WHERE visits>=2
CALL (a) {
 MATCH (interaction:Interaction)-[:WITH_ADVISOR]->(a)
 WHERE interaction.status='COMPLETED'
 RETURN interaction ORDER BY interaction.occurred_on DESC,interaction.id LIMIT 1
}
RETURN a.full_name AS Advisor,fund.name AS Fund,sales/100.0 AS Sales_USD,
redemptions/100.0 AS Redemptions_USD,(sales-redemptions)/100.0 AS Net_flow_USD,
visits AS Page_views,interaction.next_action AS Recorded_next_action,interaction.follow_up_due AS Follow_up_due
ORDER BY Net_flow_USD ASC,Advisor LIMIT $limit
